meta.title: Project management
meta.seoTitle: Project management demo with a client portal
meta.seoDescription: Interactive demo with sample data: board, list, calendar and schedule with dependencies, hours and budget per milestone, a portal where your client approves deliverables, and a weekly PDF report. Construction, agency and software scenarios.

bar.title: Project management with a client portal
bar.subtitle: Board, schedule, hours and budget, plus a portal where your client sees progress and approves deliverables.
bar.sampleHint: Companies, clients, tax IDs, people and figures are fictitious. Everything runs in your browser.
bar.resetBody: Your changes in all three industries (tasks, hours, approvals, projects) are deleted and the sample data is generated again with today's date.

healthReason.none: No alerts: tasks on time and budget in line with progress.
healthReason.milestoneLate: Milestone “{name}” ended {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago without being finished.
healthReason.oneOverdue: 1 overdue task: {task} ({days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} late).
healthReason.manyOverdue: {count} overdue tasks; the latest one: {task} ({days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}).
healthReason.overBudget: Budget spent ({spent}%) is ahead of progress ({progress}%).

nav.label: Demo navigation
nav.ragBody: An assistant that answers questions about the project's minutes, contracts and specifications and cites the source. It is not part of this demo: try it in the RAG demo with your own document.

header.summary: {tasks, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} · {progress}% complete

strip.none: This project has no milestones. Add them in Project settings.
strip.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
strip.endedAgo: ended {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago
strip.burndownAria: Remaining hours chart: {remaining} of {total} hours left
strip.closeBody: {count, plural, =0 {All tasks in the sprint are done.} one {The unfinished task moves to the next sprint.} other {The # unfinished tasks move to the next sprint.}} The sprint is marked as closed in the reports.

guide.title: Try this in 2 minutes
guide.portfolio: Check the portfolio: each project's status light and the reason for it.
guide.move: Move a task to the client review column (drag it or use the ⋮ menu): the client is notified (simulated).
guide.client: Open the client view and approve a deliverable or request changes.
guide.reports: See hours, budget per milestone and team workload in Reports.
guide.weekly: Generate the weekly report as a PDF and the WhatsApp message.

kanban.hint: Drag cards between columns or use each card's ⋮ menu (works on mobile). Click a title to see the details.
kanban.clientHint: Whatever you place here shows up in the client portal for approval.
kanban.lateDays: {count, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}
kanban.deleteBody: “{task}” and its logged hours will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

calendar.hint: Tasks by due date and milestone end dates. Click a task to open it.

timeline.hint: Bars follow each task's start and due dates. Arrows are finish-to-start dependencies; amber ones start before the task they depend on is finished.
timeline.conflicts: {count, plural, one {# dependency to review} other {# dependencies to review}}

reports.kpiProgressSub: Estimated hours of finished tasks over the total
reports.kpiOverdueSub: Unfinished and past their due date
reports.milestonesSub: Cost = hours logged × each person's hourly cost + the milestone's recorded costs.
reports.billWhenDone: Billed when the milestone is finished
reports.statusSub: {count, plural, one {# task in the project} other {# tasks in the project}}
reports.loadSub: Remaining hours of tasks due in the next 14 days, across all projects, against each person's capacity.
reports.noHours: No hours logged in the last 7 days.
reports.burndownAria: Remaining hours chart for {name}: {remaining} of {total} hours
reports.expensesSub: Materials, subcontracts and other expenses that add to the milestone's spent budget.
reports.noExpenses: No costs recorded in this project yet.

billing.title: Bill milestone
billing.simulatedBody: A sample pro forma is created here and the notice to the client is recorded. In your project it connects to your e-invoicing software (for example, Siigo or Alegra) and your payment gateway (for example, Wompi or PayU) to send the payment link.

weekly.title: Weekly report: {project}
weekly.copyFailed: Couldn't copy; select the text and copy it.
weekly.intro: It is computed from the project data right now: it changes when you move tasks, log hours or the client approves.
weekly.simulated: Simulated in the demo: no message is sent. In your project it goes out by email and WhatsApp Business (with Meta-approved templates), for example every Monday.

outbox.review: Notice: “{task}” is ready for your review

portal.banner: This is how {client} sees the project in their portal. What you do here (approve or request changes) goes back to your team's board.
portal.pendingSub: Review each deliverable and approve it or request changes.
portal.pendingEmpty: Nothing awaiting approval. When the team moves a task to client review, it shows up here.
portal.approvedWaiting: You approved “{task}”; the team will close it.
portal.upcomingEmpty: No deliveries in the next 30 days.
portal.noticesSub: Simulated in the demo: in your project they arrive by email and WhatsApp.
portal.approvedToast: Deliverable approved: it moved to done on the team's board
portal.approvedManualToast: Deliverable approved: the team will close it (the automation is off)
portal.changesToast: Changes requested: the task went back to the team
portal.changesPlaceholder: e.g. Please adjust the quantities in the steel section.

task.title: Title
task.clientVisibleHint: Your client sees it and can approve it when it's in review.
task.dependsHint: Finish-to-start: this task starts when these are done.
task.hoursInvalid: Enter a number of hours greater than 0 and up to 24.
task.commentPlaceholder: Write a comment. Use the buttons to mention someone.

task.attachHint: Sample documents are generated as PDFs when you download them. Files you attach stay only in your browser during this session.
task.fileTooBig: The file is larger than 10 MB.
task.uploadedDoc: Uploaded by you · {size} KB · this session only
task.duplicated: Task duplicated into the first column

history.autoRaised: Automation: it became overdue and was raised to high priority

history.duplicated: {actor} created it as a copy of “{from}”

notif.overdueRaised: “{task}” became overdue: raised to high priority
notif.sentToClient: {who} was notified that “{task}” is ready for review (simulated)

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: {count, plural, =0 {You're all caught up.} one {# unread.} other {# unread.}}

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: All of {company}'s projects with their status light.
portfolio.rules: Status rules: behind if a milestone ended unfinished or there are 2 or more overdue tasks; at risk if there is 1 overdue task or the budget spent exceeds progress by more than 10 points.
portfolio.noFavorites: You have no favorite projects. Mark them with the star.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.subtitle: Saved in this browser.
prefs.defaultViewHint: Applied now and the next time you open the demo.
prefs.notifySub: If you turn a type off, you stop getting new notifications of that type.

notify.dueDesc: When the automation raises the priority of an overdue task.
notify.sentDesc: A copy of the notices, reports and pro formas sent to the client (simulated).

prefs.dataSub: Your changes are saved only in this browser for 7 days; after that the data is regenerated with the new date.
prefs.resetAllBody: Your changes in all three industries are deleted and the sample data is generated again.
prefs.resetSectorBody: Your changes in this industry are deleted; the other two are kept.

automations.title: Automations
automations.subtitle: Rules that really run in this demo ({sector} industry).

clientApproval.name: When the client approves a deliverable, the task moves to done
clientApproval.desc: If you turn it off, the approval is marked on the card and your team closes it by hand.

notifyClient.name: When a task moves to client review, the client is notified
notifyClient.desc: Records an email and a WhatsApp message to the client contact (simulated) and leaves you a notification.

overdueRaise.name: When a task becomes overdue, it's raised to high priority
overdueRaise.desc: Checked when you open the demo and every time you change a task; it leaves you a notification.

settings.title: Project settings
settings.name: Project name
settings.cantDeleteLast: At least one project must remain.
settings.deleteBody: “{name}” and its tasks, hours, milestones and costs will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.milestonesHint: The budget is the milestone's planned cost; the amount to bill is what you charge the client when it's finished (before VAT).
settings.teamHint: People in the workspace with their hourly cost (for the spent budget) and weekly capacity (for team workload).

integrations.intro: These connections are not active in the demo. They are set up in your implementation according to the plan and scope you choose.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.desc: Client notices and the weekly report with Meta-approved templates.

devtools.desc: For software teams: link branches, changes and tickets to tasks.

bi.name: Power BI
bi.desc: Portfolio dashboards with the project data.

sso.name: Corporate sign-in (SSO)
sso.desc: Sign in with the company account.

docs.waIntro: Here is the weekly report for *{project}* ({from} – {to}):
docs.waCompleted: Finished this week: {count, plural, =0 {nothing new} one {# delivery} other {# deliveries}}
docs.waOverdue: Heads-up: {count, plural, one {# overdue task} other {# overdue tasks}}; we're working to catch up.

footer.sample: Sample data: companies, clients, tax IDs, people and figures are fictitious. Dates are calculated from the day you open the demo. Records are in Spanish because they belong to fictitious Colombian companies.
footer.storage: Your changes are saved only in this browser (7 days). Nothing is sent to a server.
footer.integrations: Email and WhatsApp notices, invoicing and payments are simulated; in your project they connect to your services.
footer.ai: This demo doesn't use artificial intelligence: the indicators come from visible rules applied to the data.
